about:
DAS Medical operates from Kennesaw, Georgia, as a subsidiary of UFP Technologies. The company traces its roots to pioneers in the disposable equipment draping market, though a founding year is not publicly disclosed. Its management team brings more than 160 years of combined experience in sterile equipment covers and draping systems.

The company designs, develops, and manufactures single-use surgical robotic draping systems, equipment covers, and fluid control pouches. Core processes include injection molding, film extrusion and conversion, adhesive lamination and converting, component assembly, and sterile packaging. DAS also provides product design, R&D, and private-label development services. Production takes place in controlled environment rooms at its La Romana, Dominican Republic facility, while the Kennesaw site handles finished-goods distribution and raw-material warehousing.

DAS serves medical device manufacturers, particularly those in surgical robotics and single-use surgical products. Its customer base includes companies seeking FDA-cleared surgical equipment covers and robotic draping systems compatible with major robotic platforms.

DAS emphasizes its EN 13485:2016 certification (held since 2012), FDA registration as a manufacturer, contract manufacturer, and importer, and 510(k) clearance for surgical equipment covers. The Dominican Republic operation leverages CAFTA-DR provisions for duty-free entry into the U.S. and EU markets, and the company highlights transparent, collaborative relationships with clients.
